auth.breakGlassHint: RADIUS unreachable? Use the local break-glass account.

channel.title: Channels
channel.empty: No channels yet. Create one to get started.

auth.title: SRT authentication
auth.hint: SRT's own per-stream authentication — separate from the user accounts under Users. A caller must present the matching passphrase to connect.

channel.transcodingDisabledHint: Transcoding is disabled system-wide (see Settings) — only passthrough is available for new configuration.

callerStatus.title: Outbound SRT connection
callerStatus.hint: This leg dials out to a remote listener, so status is inferred from SRT statistics rather than a direct connect/disconnect signal.

tracks.title: Audio & subtitle tracks
tracks.notTranscodeNotice: This channel is in passthrough mode, which already relays the whole incoming stream byte-for-byte — including every audio/subtitle track and any SCTE-35 markers, untouched. The settings below only take effect if you switch this channel to transcode mode.
tracks.notEditableNotice: Stop this channel before editing its tracks.
tracks.probeHint: Briefly connects to this channel's configured input and lists the elementary streams actually present (PID, codec, language where signaled) — use this instead of guessing PIDs/languages blind.
tracks.probeEmpty: No streams found (or the input wasn't reachable within the probe's time limit).
tracks.audioHint: Matched against the incoming stream by language first, PID as a manual fallback/override. No tracks configured means the pre-existing single-track behavior: the first audio track found is transcoded using the template's own audio settings.
tracks.audioEmpty: No explicit audio tracks configured — using the template's single-track default.
tracks.passthroughHint: The compressed audio is relayed byte-for-byte, never decoded — this is what sidesteps AC-3's mid-broadcast channel-count changes entirely.
tracks.ac3DvbWarning: Heads up: GStreamer's muxer signals AC-3 with an ATSC-style PMT descriptor, not the DVB descriptor European receivers expect, and has no E-AC-3 support. Verify AC-3 output against your actual set-top-boxes with a TS analyzer before relying on it in production.
tracks.subtitleHint: Always passed through unmodified, never transcoded — matched the same way as audio tracks (language first, PID as fallback).
tracks.subtitleEmpty: No subtitle/teletext tracks configured — none are passed through.
tracks.scte35Pid: SCTE-35 PID (from the probe, or your own multiplex documentation)
tracks.metadataHint: Uses GStreamer's own SCTE-35 mechanism, which parses and reconstructs each splice section rather than relaying the raw bytes byte-for-byte — validate against a real stream and a TS analyzer before relying on this for strict ad-insertion compliance checks. This only covers SCTE-35 specifically; there is no way to pass through other, unrecognized data PIDs in transcode mode.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.empty: No statistics recorded yet — they appear once the channel has been started and has an active SRT link.
stats.confirmDeleteAll: Delete ALL statistics for this channel? This cannot be undone.
stats.confirmDeleteOlderThan: Delete all statistics older than {{period}} for this channel? This cannot be undone.

logs.title: Log
logs.confirmDeleteAll: Delete ALL log entries for this channel? This cannot be undone.
logs.confirmDeleteOlderThan: Delete all log entries older than {{period}} for this channel? This cannot be undone.

pids.title: PIDs
pids.notProbedYet: Click Refresh to probe the input and see what PIDs it actually carries.
pids.passthroughNotice: This channel is in passthrough mode, which relays the whole incoming stream byte-for-byte untouched — there is nothing to configure here, this is a read-only view of what the input actually carries.
pids.videoReadOnlyNotice: Video and PMT rows are read-only. GStreamer has no way to remap a PID's number, and no way to pass through an arbitrary/unrecognized data PID other than SCTE-35 — see the Tracks page for the full explanation. A rule change here only takes effect the next time this channel is started.
pids.editOnTracksPage: matched by language — edit on Tracks

connections.title: Connections
connections.eventsEmpty: No security events recorded for this channel.

template.title: Transcode templates
template.audioHint: Used as the default single audio track when a channel has no explicit per-track audio configuration of its own (see a channel's own "Audio & subtitle tracks" page for multiple tracks, passthrough, and per-track codec choice).
template.transcodingDisabledHint: Transcoding is disabled system-wide (see Settings) — existing templates can still be viewed, edited and deleted, but no new ones can be created.

users.title: Users
users.hint: RADIUS-authenticated accounts for GUI login. A new account starts as pending — an admin must approve it (and pick its role) before it can log in at all. This is separate from SRT's own per-stream authentication.
users.empty: No users have logged in yet.

security.title: Security
security.hint: Brute-force protection: 5 failed attempts (GUI login or an SRT passphrase) blocks an IP for 30 minutes; 20 blocks it permanently. Manually block or unblock an IP here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.transcodingHint: When off, no new transcode channels or templates can be created, and every active transcode channel is stopped, switched to passthrough, and restarted.
settings.transcodingDisableWarning: This will stop every currently running transcode channel, switch it to passthrough mode, and restart it. Continue?
settings.frontendPortHint: Display only — Docker fixes this mapping when the container starts. To change it: edit FRONTEND_PORT in .env and run "docker compose up -d" again.
